message.content:
The length check only validates against the input stream, not the destination slice capacity. `xdr_read_bytes` writes `n` bytes into `dst`, and `dst[n] = '\0'` writes one more byte — both can overflow the destination slice since `desc` provides no size bound check.

Answer: 10
message.reasoning_content: Buffer overflow: dst[n] write beyond slice; also n not checked against slice size. Primary bug line 10 (or 9-10). Answer: 10.
